clues.it: Nino era nella 8ª colonna e a nord di Fabio.
clues.en: Nino was in the 8th column and north of Fabio.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un baule da viaggio e a un pianoforte a coda.
clues.en: Marta was beside a steamer trunk and a grand piano.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era nella 7ª colonna e accanto a un baule da viaggio, ma non era accanto a un tappeto persiano.
clues.en: Olga was in the 7th column and beside a steamer trunk, but was not beside a persian carpet.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 4ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 4th column, in the 5th row and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 5ª colonna, accanto a una poltrona di velluto e a nord di Luca.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 5th column, beside a velvet armchair and north of Luca.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 7ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 7th row and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a una palma in vaso, ma non era accanto a il bancone della reception.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a potted palm, but was not beside the reception desk.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un tappeto persiano, a nord di Luca e al Ristorante.
clues.en: Elena was beside a persian carpet, north of Luca and in the Restaurant.

clues.it: Luca era nella 10ª riga e accanto a un lampadario o a un tappeto persiano.
clues.en: Luca was in the 10th row and beside a chandelier or a persian carpet.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: Solo Nino può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 8ª è sua.
steps.en: Nino is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 8th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 3rd.
